title: Run pane text polish: compact token counts, ASCII gate verdict glyph, tail markdown, h>=24 Overview rule in docs

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: S99 later notes and UI pass: large token counts would read better as 23.8k; ASCII mode prints a non-ASCII cross in the gate verdict line (predates S99); assistant markdown shows raw in the tail; docs/dashboard.md does not state that the pane keeps six Overview rows at h>=24. S114 later notes: the Waves engine-conflict marker should hang-indent when it wraps; the behind-main notice clips mid-word below about 52 columns (a short fallback such as 'behind main: ork daemon restart').

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Owner to pick at preflight whether tail markdown is stripped (for example leading #, *, backticks) or kept raw. UI slice: UI pass (r14).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: go test -race ./internal/tui; go test ./internal/tui -update and review; go vet; gofmt -l; slicer check; adj lint.
